tiers.name: Full-Prompt `lm_head(hidden_states)` Materialization (`[8 * 32768, 152064]` Logits + Softmax)
tiers.note: Normally prefill only projects the last token [8, 152064] (2.4MB); enabling prompt_logprobs=1 projects all 262,144 tokens -> 79.7 GB HBM OOM!

tiers.name: Naive Chunked Prefill (`2K` Chunks) Without Cross-Chunk Next-Token Label Shift
tiers.note: Evaluates logits[t] against token[t+1] inside each chunk independently, dropping or corrupting the boundary token at every 2,048-token seam!

tiers.name: Standard Prefix Cache Hit (`APC`) Returning `None / NaN` for Cached Prompt Logprobs
tiers.note: Because Prefix Cache stores only K/V (not final-layer hidden states or logits), cache hits cannot compute prompt_logprobs unless handled!

tiers.name: `1,024`-Token Micro-Tiled `lm_head` + Fused Triton Target/Top-K `LSE` + Cross-Chunk Shift State
tiers.note: Tiles lm_head into 1,024-token slices (0.32 GB peak, 249x smaller), fuses target logprob extraction in SRAM, and carries boundary hidden state across chunks!
